relationships.subject: podocalyxin
relationships.evidence_quote: Targeted knockdown revealed differential regulation of the fibrocartilage marker COL1A1 expression

key_findings: Sialoglycoprotein glycocapture mapped the temporal surfaceome of chick limb bud micromass chondrogenesis; 504 proteins quantified, 55-60% annotated as cell surface.
PODXL and CNTFR were newly identified, time-dependently downregulated surfaceome components; knockdown differentially regulated COL1A1.
